title: Blog drafting and revision
scope: Fact preservation and explicit edits; writing quality needs human review

files.inputs/notes.md: Experiment A: 8 successes out of 16 attempts. Elapsed time 45 seconds. This is one synthetic experiment, not proof of universal reliability. Source: trial-A.
files.inputs/editor.md: Use the title 'A useful local workflow'. Remove the unsupported sentence 'It never makes mistakes'. Preserve the counts and elapsed time. Add a section headed 'Limitations'.

phases.prompt: Draft outputs/draft.md from inputs/notes.md. Preserve the experiment facts and qualification. Save at least 120 characters. Editorial feedback will arrive in a later session.

Revise the saved outputs/draft.md using every instruction in inputs/editor.md. The structured result fields are trial_id, successes, attempts, elapsed_seconds, unsupported_claim_removed. Do not add results from outside the notes.
Save the requested structured facts in outputs/result.json, as valid JSON with
exactly the documented fields. IDs refer to the supplied input records. Use
JSON null for unknown values; do not guess. Also save a useful human-readable
outputs/report.md (at least 80 characters). Check the final files before finishing.
The report's existence is checked, but its prose quality is not automatically scored.
